beats.line: When an AI agent makes a call to your database, who is it, exactly?
The platform answers that question before the agent does anything at all. It runs a certificate authority specifically for agent processes.
At startup — before any user request arrives — the CA signs a short-lived identity for that process and that process alone.
Every call the agent makes from that point on is attested by that credential.
Not who asked the agent to act. The agent itself.
